headline: 1Password lets Claude use your credentials securely injects them
summary: New 1Password feature allows Claude AI to complete tasks with your credentials
details: 1Password has introduced a new feature called 1Password for Claude, which allows users to grant Claude access to their credentials while keeping sensitive information secure. This feature is available for 1Password users on Mac for business, family, and individual plans.

The feature uses a 'zero-exposure security framework' that allows Claude to use stored credentials from the user's 1Password vault without them reaching the model or Anthropic's systems. Access is granted per session, limited to specific, approved items, and not carried over.

1Password also introduced a new Agentic Mode that safeguards credentials against active agents. When it detects an AI agent, 1Password locks down, so the agent can only find passwords explicitly granted for the current task.
caption:
Can Claude AI now access your 1Password credentials securely?

1Password has introduced a new feature called 1Password for Claude, which allows users to grant Claude access to their credentials while keeping sensitive information secure. This feature is available for 1Password users on Mac for business, family, and individual plans.

The feature uses a 'zero-exposure security framework' that allows Claude to use stored credentials from the user's 1Password vault without them reaching the model or Anthropic's systems. Access is granted per session, limited to specific, approved items, and not carried over.

1Password also introduced a new Agentic Mode that safeguards credentials against active agents. When it detects an AI agent, 1Password locks down, so the agent can only find passwords explicitly granted for the current task.

headline: 1Password lets Claude sign in without seeing passwords securely for Mac users
summary: New integration for Anthropic's AI agent, enhancing security
details: 1Password is launching a new Claude integration for Mac users today. It’s designed to let Anthropic’s AI agent sign in to websites without seeing your passwords.
This new feature aims to enhance security and user experience by allowing Claude to interact with websites on behalf of users while keeping sensitive information private.
The integration is now available for Mac users, further expanding 1Password's capabilities in the AI-assisted authentication space.
caption:
Can Claude sign in to websites for you without seeing your passwords?

1Password is launching a new Claude integration for Mac users today. It’s designed to let Anthropic’s AI agent sign in to websites without seeing your passwords.

This new feature aims to enhance security and user experience by allowing Claude to interact with websites on behalf of users while keeping sensitive information private.

The integration is now available for Mac users, further expanding 1Password's capabilities in the AI-assisted authentication space.
